sentences.en: The lab assistant was able to replicate the results.
sentences.zh: 实验室助手能够重复得到这些结果。

sentences.en: I don't think this study has ever been replicated.
sentences.zh: 我认为这项研究从未被复制过。

sentences.en: No one was able to replicate the results of that study.
sentences.zh: 没有人能复制那项研究的结果。

senses.zh: 复制品；八音阶间隔的反覆音

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（重新）+plic（重叠）+ate（做） →再重叠（一份）→复制
